question: What collective domain encompasses all earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: They belong to a complete field-group.
inference: The complete field-group comprises all earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: sarvakṣetrakam may denote a total field, group, or domain.
plain_english: This is the complete field of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
